summary: William the Conqueror defeats Harold II at the Battle of Hastings and becomes king of England.

summary: The First Crusade sets out for the Holy Land, capturing Jerusalem in 1099.

summary: King John of England seals the Magna Carta at Runnymede, limiting royal power and establishing the rule of law.

summary: The thirteen American colonies declare independence from Britain on July 4.

summary: Charles Darwin publishes his theory of evolution by natural selection.

summary: War breaks out between the Union and the Confederacy after the attack on Fort Sumter.

summary: The Confederacy surrenders; President Abraham Lincoln is assassinated five days later.

summary: The United States buys Alaska from Russia for 7.2 million dollars.

summary: Dmitri Mendeleev publishes the first widely recognized periodic table of the elements.

summary: Alexander Graham Bell patents the telephone in the United States.

summary: Thomas Edison demonstrates a long-lasting incandescent light bulb.

summary: Karl Benz patents the Benz Patent-Motorwagen, widely regarded as the first practical automobile.

summary: The Eiffel Tower is completed in Paris for the 1889 World's Fair.

summary: New Zealand becomes the first country to grant women the right to vote.

summary: The modern Olympic Games are revived in Athens, Greece.
title: First modern Olympic Games

summary: Marie and Pierre Curie discover the radioactive elements radium and polonium.
title: Radium and polonium discovered

summary: The Wright brothers make the first sustained powered airplane flight at Kitty Hawk, North Carolina.
title: First powered flight

summary: Albert Einstein publishes papers on special relativity, the photoelectric effect, and Brownian motion.
title: Einstein's miracle year

summary: The Ford Model T begins mass production on the assembly line, making cars affordable.
title: Ford Model T introduced

summary: China's last imperial dynasty ends and the Republic of China is founded.
title: Qing dynasty falls

summary: The RMS Titanic sinks on its maiden voyage after striking an iceberg.
title: Titanic sinks

summary: After the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand, war erupts across Europe.
title: World War I begins

summary: The Bolsheviks seize power in the October Revolution, leading to the Soviet Union.

summary: The Armistice of November 11 ends the fighting; the war killed an estimated 16 million people.
title: World War I ends

summary: The peace treaty formally ending WWI imposes heavy terms on Germany.

summary: The 19th Amendment grants American women the right to vote.
title: US women's suffrage

summary: Charles Lindbergh makes the first solo nonstop flight across the Atlantic, New York to Paris.
title: Lindbergh's transatlantic flight

summary: Alexander Fleming discovers penicillin, the first widely used antibiotic.
title: Penicillin discovered

summary: The US stock market crashes in October, triggering the Great Depression.

summary: Adolf Hitler is appointed Chancellor of Germany in January.
title: Hitler becomes German Chancellor

summary: Germany invades Poland on September 1; Britain and France declare war.

summary: Japan attacks the US naval base at Pearl Harbor on December 7, bringing America into WWII.

summary: Germany surrenders in May; atomic bombs fall on Hiroshima and Nagasaki in August and Japan surrenders. The United Nations is founded in October.

summary: India gains independence from Britain on August 15; Pakistan is created as a separate state.
title: Indian independence

summary: Israel declares independence on May 14.

summary: Mao Zedong proclaims the People's Republic of China in Beijing on October 1.
title: People's Republic of China founded

summary: The North Atlantic Treaty Organization is established by twelve founding members.

summary: North Korea invades South Korea in June, beginning the Korean War.
title: Korean War begins

summary: Watson and Crick publish the double-helix structure of DNA.

summary: Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay become the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest.
title: Mount Everest summited

summary: The Soviet Union launches Sputnik 1, the first artificial satellite, starting the Space Age.

summary: Fidel Castro's forces take Havana in January, establishing a revolutionary government in Cuba.

summary: US President John F. Kennedy is assassinated in Dallas on November 22.

summary: The civil rights leader is assassinated in Memphis on April 4.

summary: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin become the first humans to walk on the Moon on July 20.

summary: Intel releases the 4004, the first commercial microprocessor.
title: First commercial microprocessor

summary: Apollo 17 lands on the Moon in December, the final crewed lunar mission.

summary: Saigon falls in April, ending the Vietnam War.

summary: The Apple II personal computer launches, helping start the home-computer era.

summary: Deng Xiaoping's reforms begin opening China's economy to the world.
title: China's reform and opening begins

summary: The Shah is overthrown and Iran becomes an Islamic republic.
title: Iranian Revolution

summary: The World Health Organization declares smallpox eradicated, the only human disease wiped out worldwide.
title: Smallpox eradicated

summary: The Space Shuttle Columbia makes the program's first orbital flight.
title: First Space Shuttle flight

summary: A reactor explodes at the Chernobyl nuclear plant in Ukraine, the worst nuclear accident in history.

summary: The Berlin Wall falls on November 9, symbolizing the end of the Cold War division of Europe.
title: Fall of the Berlin Wall

summary: Tim Berners-Lee proposes the World Wide Web at CERN.
title: World Wide Web proposed

summary: East and West Germany reunite on October 3.
title: Germany reunified

summary: The USSR is formally dissolved in December after 69 years.

summary: Nelson Mandela becomes South Africa's first Black president after the end of apartheid.
title: Mandela becomes president of South Africa

summary: Britain hands Hong Kong back to China on July 1.
title: Hong Kong handover

summary: Google is founded in California in September.
title: Google founded

summary: Scientists announce a working draft of the human genome.
title: Human Genome Project draft announced

summary: Terrorist attacks destroy the World Trade Center in New York and damage the Pentagon on September 11.
title: September 11 attacks

summary: Wikipedia, the free online encyclopedia, launches on January 15.
title: Wikipedia launched

summary: The sequencing of the human genome is declared complete.
title: Human Genome Project completed

summary: Facebook launches from a Harvard dorm room in February.
title: Facebook launched

summary: YouTube is founded in February and quickly becomes the dominant video platform.
title: YouTube founded

summary: Twitter launches, popularizing short public messaging.
title: Twitter launched

summary: Apple introduces the iPhone, beginning the modern smartphone era.
title: iPhone introduced

summary: Barack Obama is elected the first Black president of the United States in November.
title: Barack Obama elected US president

summary: The Bitcoin network goes live with its genesis block in January.
title: Bitcoin network launched

summary: Instagram launches in October and is acquired by Facebook two years later.
title: Instagram launched

summary: US forces kill Osama bin Laden in Pakistan on May 2.
title: Osama bin Laden killed

summary: CERN announces the discovery of the Higgs boson on July 4.
title: Higgs boson discovered

summary: Nearly 200 countries adopt the Paris climate agreement in December.
title: Paris Agreement adopted

summary: The UK votes to leave the European Union in June.
title: Brexit referendum

summary: The Event Horizon Telescope releases the first direct image of a black hole in April.
title: First image of a black hole

summary: The WHO declares COVID-19 a pandemic on March 11.
title: COVID-19 declared a pandemic

summary: Russia launches a full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24.
title: Russia invades Ukraine

title: Chandrayaan-3 lands on the Moon
